source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
habitat_source_reported: Native to sandy woods of southeastern and eastern Texas; source also describes escape from cultivation in Tarrant County
